TypeScript language server slow startup (10-30s)
mitigation: Phase 2 forces initialize + initialized before declaring success; Phase 4 uses a 30s startup timeout outside the per-tool timeout

text: Pyright diagnostic flow differs from TypeScript
mitigation: Phase 9 includes a fixture-level test that Pyright returns diagnostics within 2s of didOpen

text: prepareRename vs rename disagreement
mitigation: When prepareRename returns null, set canRename false; when rename returns null after prepareRename accepted, surface canRename false with a violations entry

text: WorkspaceEdit with many cross-file edits is slow to diff
mitigation: Cap diff output per file at 200 lines; surface editCount in response

text: References can return 10k+ in large repos; truncation to 200 hides the rest
mitigation: Response includes truncated true, returned, referenceCount totalKnown; V1 explicitly accepts this limit

text: Spec ambiguities not surfaced by the review pass
mitigation: Each phase exit test is source of truth; if spec is ambiguous, implementer pauses and asks

text: Language server binary not on PATH
mitigation: LspClientManager.spawn checks command -v and throws lsp_server_unavailable with clear message; Phase 2 and 9 include negative-case tests

text: Symlink handling: a symlink inside workspace pointing outside could pass the naive check
mitigation: Use realpath on the resolved candidate before the workspace-equality check (decision D8)

text: Cross-tool error code inconsistency
mitigation: A single toolErrors.ts module maps known failure modes to error codes; Phase 1 establishes this module first
